decisions.reason: As a close-to-core formwork profile line with several models and its own page, it fits the firm's modular systems strategy and is worth keeping while market feedback is still early.

This automation-related add-on builds directly on the firm's established factory equipment offer and supports its stated growth direction, so management would keep the option open despite limited evidence so far.
A shuttering magnet block is a close complement to the core business and likely inexpensive to keep available, so the firm would continue it while demand becomes clearer.
Magnetic formwork strips are strongly aligned with the firm's existing solutions and the dedicated web presence suggests enough commitment to continue rather than exit quickly.
This magnetic formwork component sits near the core offer and can be retained as a relatively low-cost option within the firm's broader formwork portfolio.

Although it appears less prominently than some other launches and may overlap with related magnetic components, it is still close to the core range and cheap enough to keep on the market for another year.
